releases.title: Longer KPI formula value names
changes: Allow KPI formula value names up to 255 characters (was 100).
Add matching maxlength and client-side validation on the KPI formula builder.

releases.title: Project assign users picker
changes: Replace the project Assign users search and native dropdown with a searchable picker matching the app's select style.
Show user initials, designation, and department in the picker and assigned list, with search by name, calling name, and org fields.

releases.title: GitHub update
changes: Commit Vite production build assets for v2.0.9.

releases.title: GitHub update
changes: Add olexto developer credits and Sri Lankan timezone across the app.

releases.title: Calling name and employee name fields
changes: Simplify user names to Calling name and Name only, mapped from Excel Calling Name and Middle Initials.
Add users:sync-excel and users:sync-emails-from-excel commands for employee master updates.
Re-sync all employees from DSI Employee List Excel with calling names restored.
Show Calling name and Name on Users list view, profile, dashboard, and user forms.

releases.title: Employee master data and user UX
changes: Add calling name, middle initials, name, and joined date fields for users.
Seed plants, departments, designations, and employees from DSI Employee List Excel.
Import profile photos by EPF into storage, with object-fit display and lightbox.
Super Admin set password, auto-reset, and bulk password reset with CSV download.
Self password change no longer requires the current password.
Users page card/list view toggle; Users tree search by name, email, EPF, and org fields.

releases.title: KPI company and plant
changes: Add required company and plant selection when creating or editing KPIs, with list filters and detail display.

releases.title: Short value names
changes: Show abbreviated formula value names in KPI results history Values column.

releases.title: Financial year filter
changes: Add quick Financial Year selectors (1 Apr to 31 Mar) on KPI detail date range.

releases.title: Route fix
changes: Fix Create KPI 404 by registering kpis/create before kpis/{kpi}.

releases.title: Favicon update
changes: Replace site favicon with KPI brand icon.

releases.title: Deploy fix
changes: Commit Vite production build assets so shared hosting can load CSS/JS without running npm.

releases.title: Initial 2.0 release
changes: DSI KPI Monitoring System baseline release.
KPI formulas, feed history, date-range filters, and progress charts.
Projects, task list, task board, and quick access.
Role-based access for Super Admin, Admin, and User.
Software versioning and Super Admin changelog.
